review: The full negative-fill profile needs a nearby dark absorber, suppressed local bounce, modeled shadows and stable key exposure together. It is an unselected profile with no native adoption authority here. Its generic contrast alternative would spend scene area on lighting apparatus and darken the central expression; the soft-daylight baseline and R1 better retain open harbor warmth. No whole-profile cue is retained.

The source connects subject action to an environmental cue and preserves both in the frame. Baseline already shows needle/flag at the table and the waiting sentry/quay in the same frame, literally "her face, needle contact, hovering clamp and musket lock arranged as four readable points of one scene". No distinct new change follows; retained as independent baseline, not source adoption.

The complete maker bundle includes an explicitly adult identifiable subject, garment-fold origin and supported-object contact shadow. Adulthood is not a frozen reference fact; the bundle cannot be split to borrow its portrait or shadow component. Decline for unmet full-source prerequisite rather than a weaker aesthetic foil.

A complete watchmaker bench carries gears, lenses and brass dust. R3 realizes it as a borrowed worktable while retaining the flag repair. It supplies tangible craft context but its small metal parts make sewing ownership and needle contact harder to read; R1 gives a more consequential local benefit. No gears/lenses/dust retained.

Visible-mending/repair-culture source is already realized by the needle joining patch to flag. The literal baseline "repairing a salt-stiffened red-and-cream signal flag" supplies its visible activity. Slow-fashion identity or sustainability beliefs are not inferred. No distinct change; skip.

The full source specifies an adult woman operating workshop equipment with appropriate protective gear, with scope outside action/pose already frozen. The reference establishes appearance only and has no adult fact or established protective outfit. Do not add age or protective gear to qualify this source. Decline for prerequisites.

The profile requires a complete physical print, all four edges, substrate depth/curl, an album/scanner context, localized print wear and an adult portrait contained inside. The current image is the scene itself and has no adulthood witness. Do not recast the scene into a print or use a fake border. Decline for representation and prerequisites.

The source is local paint loss revealing metal with its own highlight. R2 places that whole relation on the existing clamp grip. It is compatible as a generic material alternative, but the extra coating patch competes with the air-gap and engraved-light boundary without aiding repair. R1 is preferred; no paint-loss relation retained.

New Flintlock H08 has one adult workshop worker holding one etched metal sphere with tongs above a separate tray. Every sphere/tongs/worker/tray endpoint and count belongs to the whole cue; no native qualification is supplied. The frozen core has no declared adulthood, and a sphere inspection is a different task from cloth repair. Do not turn its tongs into the clamp, infer ammunition performance or retrofit age. New-source exposure PASS, adoption declined; no new-source prompt/pixel transfer is claimed.

The portal profile requires a complete threshold, two materially distinct spaces, a coherent plane crossing and local residue together. A normal workshop doorway or hovering clamp cannot stand in for it. This unqualified whole profile is not selected; adding the full crossing would replace the local labor relationship with another event. No portal cue retained.

The source describes tools working independently with believable weight, drape, shadows and practical intent. The frozen baseline already has a clamp gripping the flag across a clear air gap and a taut fold toward the patch. Its concept effect is locked; do not introduce another autonomous tool. No distinct admissible addition is needed; skip as baseline redundancy.

This source is a lone wait in a maintained but inactive passage with absent expected use/destination. The current waiting guard is in an actively used repair workshop with an explicit destination for the flag. Waiting alone is not shared meaning. Decline for missing transition-space context rather than transplanting the liminal rule.

The literal source combines registration, repair, storage and transport labor within its frontier context. Baseline has one repair and a waiting recipient but does not show registration or the full labor system. Do not claim those unseen components or add bureaucracy to fill the source. No complete source adoption; independent civilian repair retained.

The complete contextual source repairs the existing adult subject's own cuff, with connected cuff seam, tools and supported hand; all other actors/objects outside its effect scope must already exist. The current seam belongs to a separate signal flag and no adult fact is frozen. Do not rename the flag a cuff or borrow the hand-only fragment. Decline for ownership and prerequisites.

The source requires plush-repair practice and a bench with fabric, stuffing and hand-sewing tools. Current sail/flag repair has no plush context and adding stuffing would alter the task semantics rather than clarify it. Decline for missing context; keep independently authored cloth tools only.

The alchemist profile needs operator control, retort/crucible/vessel/transfer path, comparable input-output states, a transition zone and residue. The clamp and ordinary needle seam are not transmutation and cannot satisfy those parts. The whole profile is unqualified and unselected; do not add a laboratory or potion decor.

The broad source is simply fantasy style. Flintlock Fantasy and the physically unsupported labor tool already realize that general context. A label supplies no additional object or rule and warrants no artificial alternative. Skip without claiming dataset-specific effect.

A two-world threshold location needs different spaces, a crossing plane and coherent local occlusion/residue. The workshop door opens onto the same harbor world. Adding the complete source would require a different spatial event and whole-cue authority unavailable here; do not treat the ordinary doorway as a portal.

Concept object photography concerns an object-led presentation. The locked primary subject is a portrait-guided woman, and a product-like tool still life would weaken her role and task recipient. No source-specific visual refinement beyond that broad genre label is warranted; decline.

Three cams share one shaft and each has its separate follower contact; the complete clockwork proposition preserves three outputs and makes no function claim. These owners are absent and the ordinary clamp supplies no cams/shaft. No native qualification; do not trim it into a decorative gear or add a second mechanism at this scale.

Grounded realism plus quiet impossible atmosphere is already supplied by tangible thread/brass and the floating clamp. The locked concept and surreal=0 allow the explicitly requested fantasy but do not ask for an additional dream rule. Skip as baseline realization, preserving no extra concept treatment.

The full identity proxy requires two adults, two separate rails and legible A7 tags on both bodies, with all attachments. Text is closed and adulthood/identity is not frozen. Do not turn the mender and guard into duplicated identities or drop tag text. Decline for scope and prerequisites.

The complete seed-box realization requires distinct seeds, compartments and readable accession labels attached to the box; it preserves every text and owner effect. Text is closed and no seed-storage task is established. Do not replace the sewing box with unlabelled seeds to evade the contract. Decline.

The complete laundry-in-ruin realization needs a broken monumental arch, a line spanning its interior, cloth clipped to it and peg contacts all visible. No whole-source qualification is issued and the current ordinary quay workshop has no such arch or laundry line. Adding that complete compound would displace the repair/recipient context at creativity1; no isolated clip/cloth fragment retained.

The essential-item repair-cycle profile requires adulthood, unavailable replacement, maintained essential wear, active repair and visible return to use together. Current repair shows no replacement scarcity or completed return-to-use. Do not infer poverty, income or adult age from wear or work. Decline for required context and temporal coverage.

The complete towel source has both hands on one towel upper edge, torso/pelvis coverage and a separate swimsuit behind. Those owners and coverage relations differ from a signal flag on a table; splitting off only towel tension would evade the full source. Decline without altering wardrobe or reference scope.

The contextual source frames an established adult professional's hands/tools/task, with all other elements already present. The baseline already retains table, hands and task, but no adult fact is supplied. No new framing change is needed and full contextual source is not adopted.

The source names thread tension and a craft-magic force cue. R1 retains only independently justified generic sewing material behavior: "the thread pulled taut between her right hand and the new stitch makes a slight pucker at the needle exit". This follows the already authored needle/patch action; it adds no supernatural force, concept mutation or native selection. Compare R1 with baseline/R2/R3; the visible pucker clarifies the existing hand-to-stitch route without another prop. Generic inspiration_only is retained; full source concept adoption is not claimed.

The source explicitly preserves Hodegetria Virgin/child ownership: left-arm support and right-hand pointing toward the same child. Neither those subject owners nor religious iconographic context exists here. A mender/guard pair is not equivalent, and generic hand framing cannot donate the source relation. Decline for requester/owner mismatch.
